g.text: Shelter Map - Shelter API (read + write + community reviews)
GET /admin/shelters?status=&source=&q= : List<AdminShelterDto> ' ALL statuses incl. hidden
GET /admin/reports?shelterId= : List<AdminShelterReportDto> ' shelter-report queue, newest first
POST /admin/reports/{id}/dismiss : 204 ' idempotent; the row is KEPT
GET /admin/review-reports : List<AdminReviewReportDto> ' newest first; hidden reviews included
POST /admin/shelters/{id}/status (body : AdminShelterStatusRequest) : 204 ' USER rows only; restore disarms auto-hide
DELETE /admin/shelters/{id} : 204 ' hard delete (cascade); USER rows only
listShelters(status : ShelterStatus, source : ShelterSource, q : String) : List<AdminShelterDto>
hideReview(reviewId : long) : void ' idempotent; never deletes the row
restoreReview(reviewId : long) : void ' idempotent; clears hidden_at,
submitter : String ' the creator's profile name; null for registry
rating : Double ' visible-review average; null = none (same as public)
occupancy : Occupancy ' the fresh (<= 2 h) block; null when nothing fresh
dismissed : boolean ' dismissed_at != null; dismissed rows stay in the queue
shelterStatus : ShelterStatus ' the shelter's LIVE status (drives the UI restore shortcut)
id : Long ' the REPORT row's id
reviewHidden : boolean ' the review's hidden_at marker
reviewId : Long ' the REVIEW's id (the action target)
findAll(source : ShelterSourceFilter, reviewed : Boolean, minRating : Integer, hasCapacity : Boolean) : List<ShelterDto>
addReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : SaveResult
updateReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : ShelterReview
nonexistentReports : int ' V9 (D1): 0 when none; > 0 = the orange
statusFlag : ShelterStatusFlag ' V9 (D1): CLOSED vs OPEN_CONFIRMED net
occupancy : Occupancy ' V9 (D4): the fresh (<= 2 h) block; null
reportCount : int ' fresh reports agreeing with it:
lastReportedAt : Instant ' the newest fresh report's time
band : OccupancyBand ' the latest fresh band (ties: user id)
detail : String ' @Size(max = 500) - free text for OTHER only
detail : String ' @Size(max = 500) - free text for OTHER only
hidden : boolean ' V9 (D2): community-hidden (5th report); hidden rows
resolve(url : String) : Outcome ' Resolved / NotFound / UpstreamFailure
(maps.app.goo.gl is the only host the client sends) + a manual
<=3-hop redirect walk (every hop re-validated - auto-follow stays
OFF) under a 10 s budget (3 s connect / 5 s read per hop).
One generic 400 for every not-found variant (invalid input /
non-whitelisted host / no extractable pair / outside Estonia -
no enumeration); one generic 502 for every upstream failure
fetch(url : String) : RedirectHop ' one hop, status + Location header
Real hop fetcher: 3 s connect / 5 s read per hop, redirects NOT
auto-followed, no cookies, fixed User-Agent; the status line +
Location header only - never the body.
The shared long-form map-URL pattern list, with the Estonia-bbox
gate + (lng,lat) auto-swap - the same rules the frontend parser
uses; both sides tested against the same fixture table.
reportShelter(user : User, shelterId : long, type : ShelterReportType, detail : String) : void
reportOccupancy(user : User, shelterId : long, band : OccupancyBand) : void
ADMIN MODERATION (admin-moderation) - the trust layer's human lever.
Authorization (D2): FRESH kind lookup per request - the JWT's userId is
loaded and UserKind.ADMIN is required (no role claim in the token, so a
demotion takes effect on the next request). 401 anonymous (the security
entry point - /admin/** is in the authenticated set) -> 403 authenticated
non-admin -> 404 unknown id -> 409 registry row under a write (D4) ->
400 malformed body. All writes are 204, single-row, no bulk endpoints.
id-ordered, batched trust fields + the submitter's name; status/
source exact-match, q = case-insensitive name/address substring
only; registry -> 409 import-owned). A RESTORE sets autoHideDisarmed
= true - permanently disarms auto-hide (V9 D1: later NON_EXISTENT
shelter reports, review reports, occupancy - all FKs ON DELETE
CASCADE); USER rows only; the only path that deletes a USER row for
first, with the shelter's LIVE status + the reporter's profile name
dismissed_at ONCE (idempotent); the row is KEPT (records the
first, hidden reviews INCLUDED with their marker + the review excerpt
can hide BEFORE the 5th-report threshold); {id} = the REVIEW's id
the review re-joins the rating, the count and the reviewed filter
D4: registry rows (source != USER) are READ-ONLY for admins - the
registry import owns their lifecycle and rebuilds them as ACTIVE on every
run, so an admin edit would silently revert (the UI offers no actions for
them; the lever for bad registry data is upstream, Päästeamet).
ACTIVE rows ONLY since V9 - auto-hidden shelters are absent; the optional
trust filters reviewed / minRating 1..5 (else 400) / hasCapacity compose
with source, applied in the projection)
auto-hidden; the detail read additionally carries yourOccupancyBand)
409 when the caller already has 10 ACTIVE USER shelters - ADMIN kind
exempt; deletions and auto-hidden rows free the cap)
ALL statuses incl. auto-hidden, NOT public)
404 unknown shelter; 409 duplicate (shelter, user, type) - checked before
the throttle budget; 429 report throttle. The 5th NON_EXISTENT auto-hides.
one live band per user per shelter, latest wins; 404 unknown; 429 throttle;
no 409 - a re-send is the update. Display-only, fresh <= 2 h at read time)
LocationController - 400 ONE generic message when no pair / outside
Estonia / non-whitelisted host; 502 ONE generic retry-later message on
upstream failure - no enumeration, no upstream detail)
Author check (PUT/DELETE): 404 if absent, 403 if not the author - registry rows and
legacy created_by-NULL rows are unmanageable by anyone (ids are public, so
403-vs-404 leaks nothing). PUT re-checks the Estonia bbox - one shared gate with
Deferred: nearest/bbox queries need GeoService + PostGIS GIST index.
Paging deferred: Estonia-scale data is small; add limit/offset when it grows.
shelters.created_by (V7): BIGINT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL +
idx_shelters_created_by. addPlace sets it (the submitting user); NULL for registry
rows and pre-V7 legacy USER rows. GET /mine queries it; PUT/DELETE gate on it.
Community rating IS the moderation - no moderator role.
- One review per user per shelter (unique shelterId+userId); re-rating updates
- Requires an authenticated, VERIFIED account (any VerificationClaim)
- V9 (D2): reportReview - verified users report any NON-OWN review
429 throttle); the 5th report sets hidden_at (once, never cleared
automatically, never deletes). Hidden reviews are excluded from the list
(except the author, marked hidden), the rating aggregate, the review
- Aggregates computed per request in v1; denormalize onto Shelter or
403 if not verified / not author / own review
report counts by type (one batched query)
fresh isAdmin(userId) kind lookup PER REQUEST (D2)
findAllForAdmin (the same batched projection - no N+1)
the ONLY manual status path + the ONLY admin delete (USER rows)
dismiss stamps dismissed_at (once, idempotent; the row is kept)
pair extraction on the final URL
